title: Japan's constitution says freedom of thought and conscience shall not be violated
summary: Japan's constitution says freedom of thought and conscience shall not be violated.
body: Article 19 is a single rule: freedom of thought and conscience shall not be violated. The source says: "Freedom of opinion/thought/conscience Article 19 Freedom of thought and conscience shall not be violated." Article 20 then treats religion separately, including a ban on religious organizations exercising political authority and a ban on the state and its organs giving religious education.
